title: Controlled regional failback
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Restore a region and fail back; reject return before synchronization/ownership checks.

sourceContract.readme: S119 | Regional failback: Synchronize recovered capacity before progressively returning users.
sourceContract.backlog: D-S119 | Add controlled failback after recovered-region synchronization.
sourceContract.acceptance: Data/ownership gates precede gradual return; users and committed effects survive failback.
sourceContract.portableCard: A-S119 | Restore a region and fail back; reject return before synchronization/ownership checks.
sourceContract.nativeSibling: B-S119 | Conduct one controlled failback; verify gated data/ownership and measured client continuity.

preconditions: Every observation is fixed fictional teaching DATA only.
Fictional Cobalt committed sequence 240 under contract-v4.
Recovered Amber requires synchronized state, sole writer epoch 8 and old Cobalt writer fenced.
25, 50 and 100 percent cohorts require 5, 10 and 20 fictional capacity units.
Two journey observations per cohort use the original 400 ms budget and exactly one committed effect.
actions: Inspect measured positive, negative and unknown results and retained history
assertions: No return before positively observed restore, synchronization and sole-writer/epoch/fence gates.
No skipped cohort or return beyond observed fictional capacity.
Intended effective routing and complete identity/session/state/effect/latency observations must pass.
Failed and unknown attempted journeys remain counted; further return is held.
Strict typed command and replay-validated state guards reject forgery and coercion.
History is retained up to 24 actions; reset restores state and keyboard focus.
CSP denies inline code, eval, connections, images and form navigation.

verification.normalVerification: READ-ONLY; does not rewrite source or evidence
verification.deliberateCapture: Only exact CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 adds a new raw browser observation file.
verification.tooling: Existing Node 22.23.4, offline Playwright 1.56.1, Microsoft-signed Edge 156.0.4314.50
verification.helper: testing\browser\isolated.cjs at 53c0c0d; openIsolatedLesson with awaited close in finally

limits: No actual region, restore, failback, capacity, synchronization, data, writer, fence, network, identity, routing, resource or cloud operation.
No native Azure evidence, source-parent acceptance, multi-writer capability, live telemetry, production Node.js 24 validation or five-nines claim.
The published browser helper's known unattended lifecycle limitation remains; an observed bounded run is not general harness qualification.
No IaC, scaffold, identity registration, credentials, deployment, packages, framework or expenditure.
A-S119 earns at most one original S credit after parent-owned acceptance; tests, proofs and repairs earn zero extra credits.
C005-C008 and local-harness catalog integration remain parent-owned.
